999008199.text: 船の墓場をなんとかしてほしい……ですか？

localizations.en: You want us to do something about the ship graveyard?

999008199.text:
はい、この東メンソス漁業組合、
組合長としてお願い申し上げます！

localizations.en: As the leader of the East Mensos Fishing Association, I implore you to help!

999008199.text:
諸島同盟にも未加入の島国が
何を泣きつくかというのは、ごもっともですが……

localizations.en: I realize it's presumptuous for an island nation not even part of the Archipelago Federation to come crying to you like this, but...

999008199.text:
えっと、その……組合長さん？
話がよく見えないんですけど……

localizations.en: Um... sir? I'm not really following...

999008199.text:
最初から順番に説明してもらえますか？
ゆっくりで大丈夫なので

localizations.en: Would you mind explaining the situation from the beginning? So that we can understand what's going on?

999008199.text:
はい……この島の近くには船の墓場と呼ばれる
大量の藻が浮かぶ海域がありまして

localizations.en: Of course... There's an area of sea near this island that is covered in massive amounts of seaweed—we call it the ship graveyard.

999008199.text: 藻って、ワカメとか、コンブみたいな？

はい。船底や櫂に藻が絡みつき
一度迷い込んだ船は出られなくなるのです

localizations.en: Exactly. The seaweed tangles around ship hulls and oars—once a vessel wanders in, it's practically stuck.

999008199.text: じゃあ、船はそのまま……

localizations.en: In other words, the ships remain there forever...

999008199.text: だからこそ「墓場」というわけね

今まではその場所を避けて漁をしていたのですが
実は最近、船の墓場の海域が広がっているのです

localizations.en: Until now, we've managed by steering clear of that area when fishing. But of late, the graveyard has been expanding its footprint.

999008199.text:
藻が大量に繁殖し、海域を避けることも難しく……
魚の水揚げ量も落ち込んでしまい……

localizations.en: The seaweed's proliferating like crazy. It's getting harder to avoid the area, and our fishing hauls have been decreasing...

999008199.text:
それは死活問題ね……他の島との交易も
やり辛くなってしまうでしょうし

localizations.en: This sounds like a matter of the island's survival... It must complicate trade with other islands too.

999008199.text: 東メンソスの皆さんがお困りなのは分かりました

localizations.en: Thanks for the explanation, that clears things up.

999008199.text:
困ってる人は見過ごせません。
神聖国の使者として、力にならせてください！

localizations.en: As an alchemist, I can't ignore people in need. In my capacity as an envoy from the sacred lands, please allow us to lend a hand!

999008199.text: おお！　ありがとうございます！
案内人アルビーナ、解決の道筋をご案内します

localizations.en: Alvina, Star Guide of Nova, will light a way forward out of this predicament!

999008199.text:
藻を減らせばいいんだよね？
だったら除草剤になるのかな

localizations.en: We just need to get rid of the seaweed, right? Maybe some kind of herbicide would work.

999008199.text:
魚や他の植物への影響を少なくするっていうのも
考えなくちゃだよね……

localizations.en: We'd need to make sure it doesn't affect the wildlife or other plants though...

999008199.text:
あの……それが実は、船の墓場にはまだ
奇妙なことがありまして……

localizations.en: Oh right, there's something else that's strange about the ship graveyard...

999008199.text:
近づくと不気味なうめき声が聞こえてくる、
と何人もの船乗りが言ってるんです

localizations.en: Many sailors say they hear eerie moaning sounds when they approach the area.

999008199.text:
不気味なうめき声？
それって、もしかして幽霊的な……アレですか

localizations.en: Eerie moaning? You don't mean... like ghosts?

999008199.text:
分かりません……ですが、人というよりは
何かの化け物のような声だという話です

localizations.en: That... I'm not sure. But the reports say the sounds don't sound human.

999008199.text:
海で不気味な声なんて……クヴァレルガみたい。
あれと似た性質の魔物なのかしら

localizations.en: An eerie voice from the sea... like that situation with Kvarelga? Could it be another Apexi?

999008199.text:
どうだろう……でも、だとしたら
こいつは強敵ときたもんだ

localizations.en: Maybe... But if that were the case, we'd be dealing with a very real threat here.

999008199.text: レスナやヴァレリアたちにも知らせないとね

localizations.en: We should let Resna and the others know about this.

999008199.text: はい。みんなで解決策を考えましょう！

localizations.en: Right. Let's figure out a solution together!
